subject.title: feat(durable): hand off wakes to session queue

question: Which PR should be the canonical release/2026.7.1 PR5 head for durable wake-to-session-queue handoff, and should queued wake `systemEvent`s intentionally survive a session-generation reset?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose between the older proof-positive branch and the refreshed replacement, or define whether an old durable wake belongs in a newly reset session; both choices affect release sequencing and persisted session behavior.

options.title: Promote refreshed PR
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107559 canonical after adding equivalent exact-head live proof and an explicit reset-generation contract, then close this PR as superseded.

options.title: Retain this PR
options.body: Keep this proof-positive PR canonical, rebase or restack it onto the intended release head, and close the refreshed duplicate after confirming no unique changes remain.

options.title: Pause durable PR5
options.body: Keep both PRs unmerged until maintainers decide that internal wake replay and its session-generation semantics belong in the current release line.

recommendation.title: Promote refreshed PR
recommendation.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107559 canonical after adding equivalent exact-head live proof and an explicit reset-generation contract, then close this PR as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current session-delivery queue and restart-recovery contract, making them the strongest available technical owner for evaluating whether this wake handoff preserves that owner boundary.
